"""
LRU Cache with Time-To-Live (TTL) Expiry
=====================================

A thread-safe LRU cache that automatically expires entries after a
configurable Time-To-Live (TTL) period. The implementation uses a
lock-free double-ended queue (deque) for the LRU ordering and a
background expiry watcher thread to keep the main cache fast.

Design Highlights
------------------
* LRU Policy: The least recently used item is evicted first.
* TTL Support: Each key carries an absolute expiry timestamp. When the
  watcher runs, any key whose expiry has passed is removed.
* Thread Safety: All public methods are guarded by a single reentrant
  lock (`threading.RLock`). The TTL watcher thread is fully independent
  and runs on its own thread; it performs only safe operations.
* Bounded Memory: The cache size is fixed at construction time. When the
  cache is full, the oldest (least recently used) entry is evicted.
* Configurable: TTL is defined in seconds (integer) or as a callable
  that receives a timestamp and returns the remaining seconds before
  expiry. This allows for more advanced TTL logic if desired.
"""
